checks.text: With no file loaded, the page shows the heading "Image Compressor", the drop zone with the text "Drop an image or click to browse", and the text "No image loaded".
After dropping a 100x100 PNG file, the preview area displays an image element with width 100 and height 100, the text "No image loaded" is gone, and the text "Original: 100x100" appears.

With an image loaded, setting the field labelled "Quality" to "50" and clicking the button "Compress" produces a download link with the text "Download compressed" and the file size text "Compressed: 1.2 KB" (value may vary but must be less than original).
With an image loaded, selecting "JPEG" in the select labelled "Format" and clicking "Compress" changes the download link text to "Download compressed.jpg" and the preview shows a JPEG image.
With an image loaded, setting the field labelled "Width" to "50" and clicking "Compress" results in a preview image with width 50 and the text "Compressed: 50x50".
Clicking the button "Rotate 90" with a 100x100 image loaded changes the preview to a 100x100 image rotated 90 degrees and updates the text to "Rotation: 90°".
Clicking the button "Flip Horizontal" with an image loaded applies a horizontal flip to the preview and shows the text "Flipped: Horizontal".

Clicking the button "Reset" with modified options restores the field labelled "Quality" to "85", the select labelled "Format" to "PNG", the field labelled "Width" to empty, and the text "Rotation: 0°".

Reload keeps the last used options: after setting Quality to "60" and Format to "JPEG", reloading the page shows the field labelled "Quality" with value "60" and the select labelled "Format" with value "JPEG".
